description: Vendors that sell training data, RL environments, evaluations, expert work or annotation to AI developers, each with what it says it sells and where its data comes from in its own words, and whether it says it pays holders for data. A to Z, not ranked.

buys.description: Only vendors that say they buy, license or pay for data from its holders.

from.description: Where it says its data comes from: licensed, customer, experts, captured, synthetic, replica, public ("licensed" means licensed from the companies or creators that hold it).

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 10, at most 50).

query.description: Words that must all appear in the vendor's name or what it sells.

sells.description: What the vendor sells: rl-environments, datasets, human-data, evals, annotation, simulation.

name: find_vendors
title: Find companies that sell AI training data
